author: codex-ai-persistence

selection.basis: Next two chronological primaries per port/sensor after January; no proposal counts, geometries, scores or image inspection used in selection.

prior_exposure.limitations: Reviewer has seen held-out test imagery and geometry correspondence. This exposure is declared, not used to choose these fixed training dates, masks or labels. References must be justified only by current-date native evidence. January experiment and hyperparameters remain fixed.

coordinate_convention: Native pixel edges [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax], half-open; exact source CRS/affine. Boundary uncertainty about1–2 native pixels. WGS84 precision is not annotation accuracy. No box-based dimensions.
method: Selection fixed chronologically before images/proposals; full native RGB followed by nearest-neighbor panels and RGB/B08 at harbor signatures. No generative editing, superresolution or changed source radiometry.
All384 asset hashes and exact preview reconstruction from numeric bands verified; common valid RGB overlaps equal.
Visible hulls manually boxed before model consultation. Zone membership uses centroid. Objects outside zones or registered quality remain contextual.
Explicit quality-supported areas only. Ambiguous raw signals removed before detector exposure. No quality override.

These train-round2 proposals require independent adjudication and a separate future dataset. January experiment and hyperparameters remain unchanged. Test exposure declared but not used in selection, labels or scopes.
annotation_notes: Terminals and much of water are obscured by clouds/shadow. No confident hull reference. A negative claim is confined to explicitly inspected quality-supported water slivers; no terminal absence claim. STC fondeo uses its own valid native mosaic.
